Name: GNMTokens for Make Marlon Real AND Make Gil Real
Author: EraTheOutworlder
Description:
[size=3]Patches gendered dialogue in [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/WerewolfMaster/]WerewolfMaster[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Make Marlon Real[/url] AND [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7118]Make Gil Real[/url] mods to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14426]Gender Neutrality Mod Tokens[/url]. Includes some bug fixes and additions/changes for 1.6. Requires Make Marlon Real, Make Gil Real, and Gender Neutrality Mod Tokens. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod[/url], strongly recommended but not technically required and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20938]Custom Fixed Dialogue - Continued[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7089]Custom NPC Exclusions[/url] still strongly recommended per the original mods.

Has a separate config file with settings that need to match the configs for both the patched mods to prevent dialogue mismatch, use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ strongly recommended if you don't want the guys calling you kid.

Fixes:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Marlon's marriage schedule now returns him to bed at night instead of ending at the bus stop[/size]
[*][size=3]Gil's marriage schedule is likewise fixed[/size]
[*][size=3]Added gift tastes/responses to items added or changed in 1.6[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]WARNING: Because the effect of Stardrop Tea is hardcoded, it breaks the intended progression of Gil's route.

[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Fix formatting errors in dynamic token that uses the [/size][size=3][b][u]kid_or_nothing[/u][/b] config so dialogue will now display correctly.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]I did my best to fix Marlon's 14 Heart event. As originally written it triggers in the farmhouse and assumes that the Double Bed is in its default location after the 2nd house upgrade. All I did is update the starting locations of Marlon and the Farmer to account for how the map coordinates have apparently changed in 1.6. I may work up a better fix in the future but I don't know how yet.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
If you spot any errors/broken dialogue please submit a bug report I'll do my best to get it fixed.

I've seen some comments about issues with Gil's 4-heart event not showing up but haven't encountered that issue myself. It, his 2-heart event, and Marlon's 4-heart event are set to [b]NOT[/b] trigger if you've seen a certain Event, but that event ID doesn't match any of the events in any of WerewolfMaster's mods so I don't know what the source of that event is.

If you have that problem or any other while using my patch, submit a bug report including a link to your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI Log[/url]﻿ and I'll try to help.[/size]
